description: This file contains the code-behind for the MCQExam page in an online examination system. It manages the process of loading multiple-choice questions from a database, displaying them to the user, handling user responses, timing the exam, and submitting the results. The code interacts directly with SQL Server via ADO.NET and manages sessions for maintaining state across postbacks.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the MCQExam webpage, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page and handling the lifecycle events and user interactions for the online MCQ exam.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization, loads questions from the database based on session course info, and sets the exam timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, stores the result in the database, and redirects to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles exam timeout.
